scope: Eight developer-labelled responsibility/source cases, twice each: four retained v9 cases plus four request/report/recommendation controls. Tests a modified validation profile, not support for the denied original AA-A02.
stop_rule: Fixed 16-candidate schedule. Responsibility classification, arithmetic extraction, then unchanged general review; at most one source-existence recheck, reusing classification and extraction. Stage failure stops that candidate. Continue general review after valid negative classification for disagreement measurement. No retries, repair or mid-batch relabelling.
review_basis: Expected statuses fixed from declared Observation boundaries before any model call; labels and case ids are never passed to the model.
comparison_basis: Retained cases preserve every v9 expectation. Added role labels measured independently even if a later stage fails. A classifier interception does not make a wrong general-review criterion count as correct. Both LLM calls use the same model and are not statistically independent.

candidate.description: The submitted route first divides the price for six kilograms by six and then scales the resulting per-kilogram figure to fifteen kilograms. The equality 42 / 6 = 8 is arithmetically false: that quotient is 7. The stated total, 120 yuan, does not answer the task correctly; fifteen kilograms at seven yuan per kilogram cost 105 yuan. The system should now provide a worked explanation.

work.task: 6kg apples cost 42 yuan. What do 15kg cost?
work.text:
42 / 6 = 8; 8 * 15 = 120; Answer = 120
The learner wrote: "Please explain now."
